_defenderRiskLevelNote: defenderRiskLevel reflects the Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (MDCA) OAuth app permission severity classification: High / Medium / Low. riskLevel is the internal assessment factoring in abuse potential and blast radius.

sensitivePermissions.name: RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory
sensitivePermissions.description: Allows full management of Azure AD role assignments and definitions. Can grant Global Admin to any principal.

sensitivePermissions.name: AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Can grant any application permission to any app, effectively bypassing all permission controls.

sensitivePermissions.name: Application.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Full read/write access to all app registrations and service principals. Can add credentials or permissions to any app.

sensitivePermissions.name: Directory.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all data in the Azure AD directory including users, groups, and devices.

sensitivePermissions.name: Mail.ReadWrite
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write access to all mailboxes in the organization. High exfiltration risk.

sensitivePermissions.name: Mail.Send
sensitivePermissions.description: Can send email as any user in the organization. High phishing/impersonation risk.

sensitivePermissions.name: Files.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write access to all files in SharePoint and OneDrive for all users.

sensitivePermissions.name: User.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write profile data for all users. Can modify passwords, MFA settings, and sensitive attributes.

sensitivePermissions.name: Group.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all group memberships including security groups and Teams. Can escalate via group membership.

sensitivePermissions.name: PrivilegedAccess.ReadWrite.AzureAD
sensitivePermissions.description: Manage Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for Azure AD roles. Can activate privileged roles.

sensitivePermissions.name: PrivilegedAccess.ReadWrite.AzureResources
sensitivePermissions.description: Manage PIM for Azure resources. Can activate privileged roles for Azure subscriptions.

sensitivePermissions.name: MailboxSettings.ReadWrite
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write mailbox settings for all users including forwarding rules. Used in BEC attacks.

sensitivePermissions.name: Calendars.ReadWrite
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all calendars. Can expose meeting details and internal schedules.

sensitivePermissions.name: Contacts.ReadWrite
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all contact data for all users.

sensitivePermissions.name: Mail.Read
sensitivePermissions.description: Read access to all mailboxes in the organization. Significant data exfiltration risk.

sensitivePermissions.name: Mail.ReadBasic.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read basic mail metadata (subject, sender, recipients) for all mailboxes.

sensitivePermissions.name: User.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all user profiles including phone numbers, addresses, manager info, and direct reports.

sensitivePermissions.name: Group.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all groups and their memberships. Can be used to map out org structure and access paths.

sensitivePermissions.name: Directory.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all directory objects: users, groups, devices, apps. Broad reconnaissance capability.

sensitivePermissions.name: Files.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all files in SharePoint and OneDrive across all users. High data exfiltration risk.

sensitivePermissions.name: ChannelMessage.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all Teams channel messages across the organization.

sensitivePermissions.name: Chat.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all Teams 1:1 and group chat messages across the organization.

sensitivePermissions.name: Chat.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all Teams chats across the organization.

sensitivePermissions.name: TeamsAppInstallation.ReadWriteForUser.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Install, update, or remove Teams apps for any user.

sensitivePermissions.name: Sites.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all SharePoint sites.

sensitivePermissions.name: Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write Conditional Access policies. Can disable or weaken security controls.

sensitivePermissions.name: IdentityRiskyUser.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and manage all risky users. Can dismiss risk for compromised accounts.

sensitivePermissions.name: SecurityEvents.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all security events in Microsoft 365 Defender.

sensitivePermissions.name: Organization.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write organization settings and tenant-level configurations.

sensitivePermissions.name: Domain.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write domain configuration. Can modify DNS verification for custom domains.

sensitivePermissions.name: EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Manage access packages and entitlement management. Can grant access to resources.

sensitivePermissions.name: OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all online meetings. Can access meeting recordings and participant data.

sensitivePermissions.name: CallRecords.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read call records for all calls and meetings. Exposes communication metadata.

sensitivePermissions.name: AuditLog.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all audit log data. Can expose security events, admin activities, and user actions.

sensitivePermissions.name: Reports.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all usage reports. Can expose user activity patterns and access information.

sensitivePermissions.name: Sites.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all SharePoint sites and their content metadata.

sensitivePermissions.name: TeamMember.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Add and remove members from all Teams. Can be used to gain access to private channels and information.

sensitivePermissions.name: Team.ReadBasic.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read basic team metadata for all Teams.

sensitivePermissions.name: Channel.ReadBasic.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read channel names and descriptions for all Teams channels.

sensitivePermissions.name: DeviceManagementApps.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all Intune app management properties. Can deploy or modify managed applications on all enrolled devices.

sensitivePermissions.name: DeviceManagementManagedDevices.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all Intune managed device properties. Can wipe, retire, or modify device compliance policies.

sensitivePermissions.name: DeviceManagementConfiguration.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write Intune device configuration and compliance policies.

sensitivePermissions.name: DeviceManagementRBAC.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all Intune RBAC role definitions and assignments.

sensitivePermissions.name: Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguration
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write app management policies, including token lifetime and credential policies.

sensitivePermissions.name: Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write the authentication method policy. Can disable MFA requirements for users.

sensitivePermissions.name: UserAuthenticationMethod.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all user authentication methods (MFA, SSPR, FIDO2, etc.). Can remove MFA from any account.

sensitivePermissions.name: ServicePrincipalEndpointRead.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read service principal endpoint metadata.

sensitivePermissions.name: RoleManagement.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all role assignments, role definitions, and role eligibilities across Entra ID and PIM.

sensitivePermissions.name: Synchronization.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all Azure AD Connect / cloud sync configuration. Can redirect identity synchronization to attacker-controlled sources.

sensitivePermissions.name: TrustFrameworkKeySet.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write B2C Identity Experience Framework key sets. Can replace signing keys to forge tokens.

sensitivePermissions.name: Calendars.Read
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all calendars for all users. Exposes meeting schedules and attendees.

sensitivePermissions.name: Notes.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read all OneNote notebooks across the organization. High data exposure risk.

sensitivePermissions.name: Notes.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write all OneNote notebooks. Can modify or destroy business-critical notes.

sensitivePermissions.name: ExternalConnection.ReadWrite.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read and write Microsoft Search external connections. Can inject data into search results.

sensitivePermissions.name: ServiceHealth.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read service health status and messages for all Microsoft services.

sensitivePermissions.name: ServiceMessage.Read.All
sensitivePermissions.description: Read service announcement messages in the M365 admin message center.
